summary: Enhance your leadership skills with our course on building inclusive teams and diverse workforces. Foster collaboration and innovation in your organization.
lede: Inclusive leadership training helps HR professionals and team leaders identify barriers to fairness and participation in their teams. It covers recognizing workplace bias, supporting psychological safety in hybrid teams, and reviewing hiring and performance processes for equity. Learners also practice using equity audits and team dashboards to assess inclusion.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for team performance, talent strategy, and organizational culture in complex, global environments.
modules: Foundations of Inclusive Leadership and ISO 30415
Measuring Diversity and Equity using GDEIB
Mitigating Cognitive Bias in Professional Decision-Making
Building Psychological Safety in Hybrid Teams
Inclusive Talent Acquisition and Retention Strategies
Leveraging Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) for Impact
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2 years of experience in a supervisory, HR, or project management role. Familiarity with basic human resource processes and team leadership concepts is recommended. No prior DEI specialization is required.
